name: Remove Object
description: Take an object out of a picture: the mask is grown a few pixels so no rim of it is left, then LaMa fills the place from its surroundings. The image comes back with the masked part filled. It is the pre-fill of the Remove action; add an edit model pass (Fill Masked's place in the Remove workflow) for the finish.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.label: Mask
inputs.description: White is what to take away.

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: A LaMa ONNX file. The picker offers the download, with its licence shown first.

inputs.name: grow
inputs.label: Grow mask
inputs.description: Pixels the mask is grown before the fill, so a rim or a shadow of the object is not left. 0 uses the mask as drawn.
